# RunZone

> RunZone (Zone 2 Running Coach) is an iPhone app that builds running plans around Zone 2 heart rate training, coaches runners live with voice cues, and tracks pace getting faster at the same heart rate. It works with Apple Watch heart rate via Apple Health, or pace-only with just a phone. Subscription: $39.99/year or $9.99/week.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/runzone-run-coach/id6816559417
- Website: https://getrunzone.app/

## Free tools
- [Zone 2 Heart Rate Calculator (Free)](https://getrunzone.app/zone-2-calculator/): Free Zone 2 heart rate calculator. Enter your age and resting heart rate to get your Zone 2 range and all five heart rate zones in seconds.
- [Running Pace Calculator + Race Time Predictor](https://getrunzone.app/pace-calculator/): Free running pace calculator. Get your pace per mile and per km from any race time, plus predicted 5K, 10K, half marathon and marathon times.
